name: Grounded answering eval v1
description: Runs all 120 items of eval-rag-grounded-v1 at temperature 0: a question over a short invented passage (80-110 words), half answerable and half not. Reports accuracy overall and by category, where lookup/combine/condition measure reading the passage and absent/near_miss measure declining when the passage does not hold the answer. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Answerable rows pass when the computed value occurs in the extracted output; unanswerable rows pass when any of the dataset's abstain phrases does (the prompt asks for NOT IN PASSAGE). Always declining scores 0.5, so read by_category.

notes: Part of the small-model tier (workloads/README.md). accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
